dashboard.welcomeSubtitle: A structured three-task journey across all 18 chapters and 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita.
dashboard.dailyWisdomSubtitle: A contemplation from the sacred dialogue for your daily reflection.

journey.title: The 18 Modules of Sacred Curriculum
journey.subtitle: 700 sequential shloka rooms structured into 18 chapter worlds. Complete each room's 3 tasks to unlock the next.
journey.lockedNotice: Complete previous chapter modules to unlock.

learningRoom.roomLockedDesc: Avyakta requires completing prior shloka rooms in strict sequential order. Complete the 3 mandatory tasks in preceding rooms to unlock this wisdom.
learningRoom.task1Subtitle: Devanagari Sanskrit, transliteration, and word-by-word meanings
learningRoom.sectionC: Section C · Gita in Real Life
learningRoom.matchingPrompt: Match each Sanskrit term on the left with its definition on the right.
learningRoom.puzzlePrompt: Arrange the verse segments into canonical Sanskrit order.
learningRoom.orderSegmentsInstruction: Click the up and down arrows to arrange the shloka lines in their authentic sequence.
learningRoom.replayNotice: This room was previously mastered. Replaying reinforces wisdom without awarding duplicate XP.

achievements.title: Journey Milestones & Achievements
achievements.subtitle: Track your badges, chapter completions, and spiritual milestones unlocked through sincere practice.

progressPage.title: My Learning Progress
progressPage.subtitle: Comprehensive overview of your sequential progress across the 700-shloka curriculum.
progressPage.chaptersSubtitle: Master each chapter sequentially through 3 mandatory tasks per shloka.
progressPage.dangerDesc: Reset all completed levels, XP, and task checkpoints back to Level 1.1. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Platform Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure interface theme (Dark / Light / Parchment), website language, audio volume, and data backup.
settings.exportDesc: Copy a secure local code containing your 700-level checkpoints, XP, and milestone achievements.
settings.resetDesc: Clears level completion checkpoints and resets to Shloka 1.1.
settings.copyCodeAlert: Game save code copied to clipboard! Keep this safe to restore your progress anywhere.
settings.resetSuccessAlert: Avyakta game progress has been reset to Level 1.1.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to access your cloud-synchronized Gita learning journey across all devices.
auth.signupSubtitle: Join Avyakta to securely save your 700-level learning checkpoints, XP, and badges.
auth.guestInviteTitle: Save Your Progress in the Cloud
auth.guestInviteText: Create an account to securely save your learning progress and continue on any device.

auth.resetPasswordSubtitle: Choose a strong password of at least 12 characters for your account.
auth.passwordResetSuccess: Password has been successfully updated! You can now log in with your new password.
auth.accountSubtitle: Manage your registered profile, cloud progression, and cross-device sync status.
auth.cloudSyncActiveDesc: Your 700-shloka progress, XP, and milestone badges are securely backed up in the cloud.
auth.importGuestText: We found existing progress on this browser. Would you like to import and verify it to your cloud account?
